messages:
maria: Kicking off follow-up from last night's token-validation 401 blips and audit gaps. Need owners, short-term mitigations, and an automated detector.

sam: I can own client mitigations. Plan: SDK jittered retries (2 attempts) + feature-flagged canary. I'll open INF-28012 and target a 48h canary. ETA 2026-04-02.

liam: I'll own audit reliability. Hypothesis: writer buffer overflow during cache churn. Plan: add write-ahead buffer with fs spill and metric dropped_audit_events_total. Opening SRE-12042. ETA 2026-04-07.

carla: Security will verify signing key state and recent IAM changes. If rotation or perm drift required, I'll coordinate SEC-6420 and a rolling update. Quick check: last rotation 2025-08-03; will confirm integrity.

maria: Action summary and deadlines:
- sam: INF-28012 - SDK retry canary, due 2026-04-02
- liam: SRE-12042 - audit buffer + metric, due 2026-04-07
- carla: SEC-6420 - key/perm review if needed, due 2026-03-30
Please add time estimates and deps.

sam: Dep: SDK release window + 48h canary. Est: 4 dev hrs + 2 QA hrs. Will add rollout notes in the JIRA.

liam: Detection rule draft (to adapt to our alert DSL):
```
expr: rate(token_audit_written_total[15m]) < 0.2
for: 10m
labels: {severity: "warning", team: "sre"}
```
I'll convert and tune after 24h.

carla: If SEC needs a key rotation we'll require a 1hr coordinated deploy window. I'll flag in SEC-6420.

ops-bot: Created recurring follow-up "token-audit-remediation" weekly on Mon 09:00 UTC for 3 weeks. Invites sent to maria, sam, liam, carla.

maria: Thanks everyone. Please post PR/JIRA links and one-line updates here. We'll close when PRs merged, JIRAs resolved or scheduled, and the new alert is quiet for 48h. :white_check_mark:
